opening_phone_call: ^Oh. You picked up. I wasn't sure you would.
^Oh uhh I just… wanted to check on you. It's been a while.
^I was listening to the radio the other day and they mentioned Oudaya...
^Reminds me of when I was a kid playing with Khadija, we always got lost in the medina.
^I'd like to see it again, but I don't think I will... I don't think I... can.
^The doctors say the treatment could be working but...
^They say one thing, but you feel another.
^Would…or can..can you go there? Maybe take a photo of my neighborhood and show me what changed.
^It's been years since I last visited…
^I wonder if Khadija and Allal still live there...
^I love you. I always have. We just never said it much.
^I love you. I always have. We just never said it much.
ch2_ouadya_neighborhood: ^I look around the neighborhood. I notice Lalla Khadija standing outside her shop.
^Oh! Um Salam! Can I help you with something?
^Salam Lalla Khadija… it's Abbass, Zohra's son.
^Oh… it's been a while since I heard that name…
^Oh, um... I am sorry about the news…
khadija_understanding: ^I understand how you feel, a wildi...
^I grew up with Zohra in this neighborhood. We both played hide and seek, went to 7anot to buy Bimo, chased down cats and dogs…
^Don't say that! She's still a great woman!
khadija_great_woman: ^Lalla Khadija: Oh, Abbass, I… didn't mean it like that… I know it's hard for you to accept that—
ch2_ouadya_neighborhood_slide2: ^[After my conversation with Lalla Khadija, I hear someone calling out to me, stopping me in my tracks.]
^Oh, umm Salam… do I know you?
^That's it, lghorba made you lose your memories. It's me, Hicham. We took the concours together, for the scholarship abroad.
^I didn't pass, but it's okay. I made a life here.
^I heard the news about your mother from Lalla Khadija…
^Everyone seems to know. I guess I'm the last one, huh…
hicham_understanding: ^Zohra wanted us to study together and become roommates… She treated me like her own son…
^You should go visit Butcher Allal. He still has his shop by the souk. He was devastated when he heard the news.
^Thanks, Hicham. She always wanted me to see him.
^She did mention him to me this morning on the phone… I'll go see him.
